provenance.publisher_series_title: Producer Price Index by Commodity: Farm Products: Tomatoes
provenance.retrieval_method: keyless FRED CSV mirror (no API key)
provenance.placeholder_policy: only real published observations are stored; missing, suppressed and non-numeric prints are dropped, never filled
provenance.revision_policy: PPI indexes are PRELIMINARY and subject to monthly revision for up to four months after original publication (BLS footnote, seen on 2026-03 and 2026-06). The monthly re-run upserts on (series_id, date, source), so revisions are picked up in place.
provenance.coverage_note: BLS itself publishes no observation for several recent months (2026-01, -02, -04, -05 as of 2026-07-24) - verified against the BLS public API, so these are genuine publisher gaps, not losses in the FRED mirror. They are stored as absences.

liveness.basis: last real observation vs newest observation in the series' own source catalog; no end_year, no item-list membership, no hardcoded flag
